b1-19-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Family Budget
b1-19-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the two of them manage their money at home. You (Meg) say that your monthly income is a hundred thousand forints and that you save twenty thousand forints a month.
b1-19-01.prompt: Tell Károly how much your monthly income is and how much you save.
cues: Say how much your monthly income is
Say how much you save each month
b1-19-01.target: A havi bevételünk százezer forint. Havonta húszezer forintot megtakarítunk.
b1-19-01.english: Our monthly income is a hundred thousand forints. We save twenty thousand forints a month.
b1-19-01.canDo: I can talk about a budget: income, expenses and savings.

b1-19-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Bank Account
b1-19-02.scenario: At the bank, the clerk asks Meg what she needs. You (Meg) say that you would like to open a new bank account and ask what the interest rate is.
b1-19-02.prompt: Tell the clerk what you would like to do and ask about the interest rate.
cues: Say that you want to open a new bank account
Ask how high the interest rate is
b1-19-02.target: Új bankszámlát szeretnék nyitni. Mennyi a kamatláb?
b1-19-02.english: I would like to open a new bank account. What is the interest rate?
b1-19-02.canDo: I can talk about bank accounts, transfers, loans and interest rates.

b1-19-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Inflation and Prices
b1-19-03.scenario: Károly says that everything is getting more expensive in the shops. You (Meg) answer that the higher inflation is, the more expensive everything is.
b1-19-03.prompt: Tell Károly how inflation and prices are linked.
cues: Say that inflation is higher and link it to prices
Say that everything is more expensive in step with it
b1-19-03.target: Minél magasabb az infláció, annál drágább minden.
b1-19-03.english: The higher inflation is, the more expensive everything is.
b1-19-03.canDo: I can talk about inflation, price rises and exchange rates.

b1-19-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Starting a Small Business
b1-19-04.scenario: Károly wants to start a small business and asks Meg for advice. You (Meg) say that it is worth writing a business plan first because then the profit is bigger, and that a business needs a good budget.
b1-19-04.prompt: Give Károly advice about the business plan, the profit and the budget.
cues: Say what is worth doing first
b1-19-04.target: Először érdemes üzleti tervet írni, mert akkor nagyobb a nyereség. Egy vállalkozásnak jó költségvetés kell.
b1-19-04.english: First it is worth writing a business plan, because then the profit is bigger. A business needs a good budget.
b1-19-04.canDo: I can talk about starting a business: profit, investment and the business plan.

b1-19-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Unemployment and Purchasing Power
b1-19-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she read about the economy. You (Meg) say that the lower unemployment is, the higher purchasing power is.
b1-19-05.prompt: Tell Petra how unemployment and purchasing power are linked.
cues: Link it to higher purchasing power
b1-19-05.target: Minél kisebb a munkanélküliség, annál nagyobb a vásárlóerő.
b1-19-05.english: The lower unemployment is, the higher purchasing power is.
b1-19-05.canDo: I can talk about the national economy: growth, unemployment and purchasing power.

b1-19-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gentleman and the Bank
b1-19-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Garanvölgyi úr and the bank is about. You (Meg) say that Garanvölgyi úr asks for a loan but has no money, and that for Pálffy Menyhért work and savings are important.
b1-19-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Garanvölgyi úr wants and what Pálffy Menyhért thinks is important.
cues: Say what Garanvölgyi úr asks for and that he has no money
Say what is important for Pálffy Menyhért
b1-19-consolidation.target: Garanvölgyi úr hitelt kér, de nincs pénze. Pálffy Menyhértnek a munka és a megtakarítás fontos.
b1-19-consolidation.english: Garanvölgyi úr asks for a loan, but he has no money. For Pálffy Menyhért, work and savings are important.
b1-19-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about money and a loan in a few sentences.
